content: Debezium/Postgres CDC: replication slot not consumed or low-traffic DB -> WAL retained indefinitely -> disk full -> DB down. Mitigations: heartbeat.interval.ms + heartbeat action query (or pg_logical_emit_message on PG14+), monitor pg_replication_slots lag, set max_slot_wal_keep_size as safety net (slot invalidation = resnapshot needed). Slot survives connector deletion — orphaned slots are the classic killer. NATS JetStream: default store_dir /tmp (lost on reboot), max_store must reflect disk, memory streams with limits retention and no max_bytes/max_age grow unbounded; avoid NFS for store; reserve 15-25% headroom over stream reservations. Sources: morling.dev slot posts, debezium docs, nats docs, synadia insights.
